ELON MUSK: A true Kardashev-scale civilization will require infrastructure beyond Earth.

Musk says the future of advanced AI could eventually demand energy at a scale our planet alone may struggle to support. That’s why long-term growth may depend on Moon bases, mass drivers and massive space-based solar power systems.

According to Musk, solar-powered AI satellites launched at enormous scale could generate terawatt-level energy, but doing so would require millions of tons of payload reaching orbit every year.

The long-term vision goes even further. Lunar infrastructure and industrialization could eventually unlock petawatt-scale power generation, making today’s global economy look tiny by comparison.

The limiting factor is no longer physics. It’s how fast humanity can build.

Day 3 at AI4 2026 — the final day — and the energy shifted completely. @Ai4Conferences w/ @ChinaAMC_HQ @rayliant @sjvtesla 

The theme was AI Beyond Work: How AI Is Entering Everyday Life. After two days focused on infrastructure and enterprise transformation, the conversation moved from software into the physical world — robotics, autonomous systems, intelligent machines, and real-world applications that are starting to leave the lab.
We spent the day on the floor with 
Jessica Vose from Kana AI (kana.ai), 
Daniel Garcia from Merge (merge.dev), 
and Steve Ancheta from Zig.AI (zig.ai), 
digging into how Agentic AI is shaping the future.

The big takeaway from the final day was clear: the next chapter of AI isn’t just smarter software. 

It’s AI that can see, move, decide, and act in the real world.

The agentic future isn’t only digital anymore. It’s becoming physical.

That’s a wrap from AI4 2026.

NEWS: Grok Build's entire agent harness is fully open source. 

Unlike platforms that only open-source parts of their stack, Grok Build gives developers access to the actual agent harness.

• Inspect the source code.
• Modify it to fit your needs.
• Compile it yourself.
• Run it with your own inference models.

A fully open foundation for developers who want complete control over their AI workflows.

Today, we’re launching Original Content Rewards.

The reality is that Revenue Sharing had reached a point where its incentives were misaligned. Creators should be focused on bringing net new content to the platform instead of maximizing payouts. We could have kept adding more rules and exceptions, but ultimately the better decision was to start fresh and build a program designed from day one to reward originality.

Original Content Rewards is the result.

This program is built around a simple idea: reward the creators who bring original ideas, expertise, creativity, and unique perspectives to 𝕏 -- not those who have become best at gaming the system.

This is just the beginning. We’ll continue refining the program, improving our models, and raising the bar over time. But we’re so excited to keep investing in the creators who inform us, entertain us, make us laugh, teach us something new, and drive meaningful conversations on 𝕏 every day.

To everyone who creates original content on 𝕏 and makes this a better platform every day: thank you. We’re excited to keep building for you.
